paragraphs: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps, where software teams and their Artificial Intelligence ("AI") agents stay in flow to ship software faster. Built with a unified data model, our platform brings together development, operations, Information Technology ("IT"), security, and business teams across the entire software development lifecycle to deliver better, more secure software faster.

AI has accelerated individual coding, but teams lose momentum coordinating across planning, testing, security, deployment, and operations. Fragmented toolchains and tool-specific AI agents create bottlenecks that slow software delivery. GitLab's intelligent orchestration helps solve this by enabling teams to orchestrate AI agents to execute tasks autonomously across the software lifecycle while maintaining quality, security, and speed.

GitLab accelerates customer innovation by reducing software development cycles from weeks to minutes. The platform eliminates the need for point tools, increases productivity, and embeds security into development workflows with automated enforcement to improve software security, quality, and compliance while enabling faster delivery.

We serve teams of all sizes, scopes, and complexities. As a result, we have more than 50 million registered users, and more than 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are GitLab customers1. We define our active customers as those with more than $5,000 of Annual Recurring Revenue, or ARR, in a given period, who we refer to as our Base Customers. A single organization with separate subsidiaries, segments, or divisions that uses our platform is considered a single customer for determining ARR.

GitLab is the only intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps built on an open-core business model. Any customer or contributor can add or enhance functionality by contributing code to the core product or extending our Continuous Integration ("CI")/Continuous Delivery ("CD") Catalog and AI Catalog. In calendar year 2025, users contributed more than 6,500 merge requests, extending our in-house research and development ("R&D") and empowering our users to improve the DevSecOps solution they use daily. Our open-core approach builds trust with our customers and enables us to maintain our high velocity of innovation. We make our strategy, direction, and product roadmap publicly available.

GitLab offers flexible deployment options. Customers can install self-managed GitLab instances in their own on-premises or hybrid cloud environments, use our fully managed SaaS offering in public or private clouds, or deploy GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant SaaS solution for organizations with complex security and compliance requirements.

Our business has experienced rapid growth. We generated revenue of $955.2 million and $759.2 million in fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2025, respectively, representing growth of 26%. During this period, we continued to invest in growing our business to capitalize on our market opportunity. The net loss attributable to GitLab was $56.0 million and $6.3 million in fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2025, respectively. Our operating cash flow margin, which we define as operating cash flows as a percentage of revenue, was 24% and (8)% for fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2025, respectively. Our gross profit margin was 87% and 89% for fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2025, respectively.

DevOps combines software development and IT operations to shorten development cycles and enable rapid, continuous software delivery. GitLab pioneered the DevSecOps platform, replacing "do it yourself" with a single platform spanning the entire software development lifecycle. Today, GitLab is an intelligent orchestration platform built on three foundational pillars, where software teams and their AI agents work together seamlessly:

•Workflows: Teams and AI agents working together. GitLab enables teams to orchestrate multiple AI agents that work in parallel across teams and projects on complex tasks spanning the entire software development lifecycle, with teams defining the rules and guardrails that guide agent behavior.

•Context: Unified data and intelligence across the lifecycle. GitLab's unified data model provides complete context across the entire software lifecycle—code, project requirements, change history, security implications, deployment constraints, and operational feedback—with our knowledge graph, GitLab Orbit, indexing repositories and metadata to enable workflows that span multiple stages without context switching or integration overhead.

•Guardrails: Governance and Compliance Built Into Flow. GitLab embeds security and compliance directly into agent workflows with policy-driven enforcement, automatic audit trails through Agent Sessions that capture agent reasoning and actions, and complete artifact traceability, enabling organizations to maintain compliance without sacrificing development velocity.

GitLab's intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps is built on a single codebase with a unified data model and user interface. The platform provides a comprehensive understanding of everything required to deliver software, project plans, code, security scans, compliance checks, and deployment configurations. GitLab is purpose-built to address the entire software development lifecycle.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Financial Position
Security and privacy breaches may hurt our business.
We face heightened risk of security breaches because we use third-party open source technologies and incorporate a substantial amount of open source and community contributed code in our products.
We face intense competition and could lose market share to our competitors, which would adversely affect our business, operating results, and financial condition.
We may not be able to respond to rapid technological changes with new solutions, which could have a material adverse effect on our operating results.
The market for our services is rapidly evolving with uncertain growth expectations which would adversely affect our future results and the trading price of our Class A common stock.
Our operating results may fluctuate significantly, which could make our future results difficult to predict and could adversely affect the trading price of our Class A common stock.

The implementation of AI and machine learning technologies in our services may result in reputational harm, liability, increased expenditures, or other adverse consequences to our business operations.
Transparency is one of our core values. While we will continue to prioritize transparency, we must also promote "responsible" transparency as transparency can have unintended negative consequences.
The publicly available GitLab Handbook, or Handbook, may not be up to date or accurate, which may result in negative third-party scrutiny or be used in ways that adversely affects our business.
Customers may choose to stay on our free self-managed or SaaS product offerings instead of converting into a paying customer.
Failure to effectively expand our marketing and sales capabilities could harm our ability to increase our customer base and achieve broader market acceptance of our services.

Any failure to offer high-quality technical support services, including success tiers, or adequately sell such services, may adversely affect our relationships with our customers and our financial results.

Our business and operations have experienced rapid growth, and if we do not appropriately and effectively manage future growth, if any, or are unable to improve our systems, processes and controls, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects will be adversely affected.

We have experienced rapid growth, both in terms of employee headcount and customer growth, as well as increased demand for our products. We anticipate that we will continue to expand our operations and responsibly grow our headcount in the near term, and our success will depend in part on our ability to manage that growth effectively, although there is no assurance that our rate of growth will continue at its current pace. Our total number of Base Customers has grown to 10,682 as of January 31, 2026 from 9,893 as of January 31, 2025. The growth and expansion of our business places a continuous strain on our management and operational and financial resources. In addition, as customers adopt our products for an increasing number of use cases, we have had to support more complex commercial relationships. To effectively manage and capitalize on our growth periods, we need to manage headcount capital and processes efficiently, while continuing to make investments to improve and expand our information technology and financial infrastructure, our security and compliance requirements, our operating and administrative systems, our relationships with various partners and other third parties. Our rate of growth may also be impacted as a result of global business or macroeconomic conditions, including inflation, tariffs, volatile interest rates, uncertainty with respect to the federal budget, debt ceiling and potential government shutdowns, volatility of the global debt and equity markets, and investment decisions by our customers.

We may not be able to sustain the pace of improvements to our products successfully or implement systems, processes, and controls in an efficient or timely manner or in a manner that does not negatively affect our results of operations. Failure to effectively manage growth or improve our systems, processes, and controls, or the failure to operate in the intended manner could result in the following adverse impacts to our business: difficulty or delays in deploying customers, declines in quality or customer satisfaction, increases in costs, difficulties in introducing new features or other operational difficulties, inability to manage the growth of our business and to forecast our revenue, expenses, and earnings accurately, or to prevent losses.

Our recent growth may not be indicative of our future growth, and we may not be able to sustain our revenue growth rate in the future. Our growth also makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and may increase the risk that we will not be successful.

Our total revenue for the years ended January 31, 2026 and 2025 was $955.2 million and $759.2 million, respectively, representing a growth rate of 26%. We monitor the following key metrics to help us evaluate our business, identify trends affecting our business, formulate business plans, and make strategic decisions.

We believe that our ability to retain and expand our revenue generated from our existing customers is an indicator of the long-term value of our customer relationships and our potential future business opportunities. Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate measures the percentage change in our ARR derived from our customer base at a point in time. Our calculation of ARR and by extension Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate, includes both self-managed and SaaS subscription revenue. We report Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate on a threshold basis of 130% each quarter or the actual number if below 130%.

We calculate ARR by taking the monthly recurring revenue, or MRR, and multiplying it by 12. MRR for each month is calculated by aggregating, for all customers during that month, monthly revenue from committed contractual amounts of subscriptions, including our self-managed and SaaS offerings but excluding professional services. We calculate Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate as of a period end by starting with our customers as of the 12 months prior to such period end, or the Prior Period ARR. We then calculate the ARR from these customers as of the current period end, or the Current Period ARR. The calculation of Current Period ARR includes any upsells, price adjustments, user growth within a customer, contraction, and attrition. We then divide the total Current Period ARR by the total Prior Period ARR to arrive at the Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate.

paragraphs: GitLab 是 DevSecOps 的智能 orchestrating 平台，軟體團隊及其人工智慧（"AI"）代理人保持流暢，以更快地交付軟體。建構於統一的資料模型，我們的平台將開發、運維、資訊科技（"IT"）、安全與業務團隊整合於整個軟體開發生命週期，以提供更優質且更安全的軟體。
AI 已加速個別程式碼的撰寫，但團隊在協調規劃、測試、安全、部署與運維時會失去動能。分散的工具鏈與工具特定的 AI 代理人會造成瓶頸，延緩軟體交付。GitLab 的智能 orchestrating 能解決此問題，讓團隊能 orchestrating AI 代理人執行任務，於軟體生命週期中自主運作，同時維持品質、安全與速度。
GitLab 透過縮短軟體開發週期從數週至數分鐘，加速客戶創新。此平台消除點狀工具的需要，提高生產力，並將安全內建於開發流程中，透過自動執行強化以提升軟體安全、品質與合規性，同時實現更快的交付。
我們服務所有規模、範疇與複雜度的團隊。因此，我們擁有超過 50 百萬註冊用戶，且超過 50% 的財富 100 公司為 GitLab 客戶1。我們將活躍客戶定義為在特定期間內有超過 5,000 美元年度經常性收入（"ARR"）的客戶，我們稱為 Base Customers。一個組織若有獨立子公司、部門或分部使用我們的平台，則視為單一客戶以計算 ARR。

GitLab 是唯一基於開放核心商業模式建構的 DevSecOps 智能 orchestrating 平台。任何客戶或貢獻者都可以透過貢獻程式碼至核心產品或擴充我們的持續整合（"CI"）/持續交付（"CD"）目錄與 AI 目錄，來增加或增強功能。在 2025 年歷年中，用戶貢獻超過 6,500 個 merge requests，擴充我們的內部研究與發展（"R&D"），並賦能用戶改善他們日常使用的 DevSecOps 解決方案。我們的開放核心模式建立與客戶的信任，並使我們能維持高創新速度。我們公開我們的策略、方向與產品路線圖。
GitLab 提供靈活的部署選項。客戶可以安裝自管理的 GitLab 實例於其內部或混合雲端環境，使用我們的完全管理 SaaS 提供服務於公有或私有雲端，或部署 GitLab Dedicated，這是我們為有複雜安全與合規需求的組織提供的單租戶 SaaS 解決方案。

我們的業務經歷快速成長。我們在財務年度 2026 年與財務年度 2025 年分別產生 955.2 百萬美元與 759.2 百萬美元的營業收入，成長幅度為 26%。在此期間，我們持續投資於業務成長，以把握市場機會。我們的淨虧損歸屬於 GitLab 分別為 56.0 百萬美元與 6.3 百萬美元。我們的營運現金流邊際率，我們定義為營運現金流佔營業收入的百分比，分別為 24% 與 (8)%。我們的毛利率分別為 87% 與 89%。
1 財富 500® 是財富媒體 IP 有限公司的註冊商標，經授權使用。此聲稱基於 GitLab 的資料。財富 100 指的是 2025 年財富 500 名單中排名前 20% 的公司，於 2025 年 6 月發佈。財富與財富媒體 IP 有限公司無關聯，也不支持 GitLab 的產品或服務。
DevOps 結合軟體開發與資訊科技運作，以縮短開發週期，並實現快速、持續的軟體交付。GitLab 領先開發了 DevSecOps 平台，取代「自行處理」的方式，以一個平台涵蓋整個軟體開發生命週期。目前，GitLab 是一個智慧型協調平台，建基於三個基礎支柱，軟體團隊與其 AI 代理之間可順暢協作：
•工作流程：團隊與 AI 代理協同作業。GitLab 讓團隊能協調多個 AI 代理，這些代理可在不同團隊與專案中並行處理複雜任務，涵蓋整個軟體開發生命週期，團隊可定義規則與防護措施，以引導代理行為。
•情境：生命週期內統一的資料與智慧。GitLab 的統一資料模型提供完整的情境，涵蓋整個軟體生命週期—程式碼、專案需求、變更歷史、安全影響、部署限制與運營反饋—透過我們的知識圖譜，GitLab Orbit 會索引倉庫與元資料，以實現跨多個階段的作業流程，而無需情境切換或整合開銷。
•防護措施：治理與合規內建於流程中。GitLab 將安全與合規內建於代理作業流程中，透過政策驅動的執行，自動化審計追蹤透過 Agent 會話記錄代理的推理與行動，並實現完整的成果追蹤，使企業可在不犧牲開發速度的情況下維持合規。
GitLab 的智慧型協調平台用於 DevSecOps，建基於單一程式碼庫，擁有統一的資料模型與使用者介面。該平台提供完整的理解，以實現軟體交付所需的一切，包括專案計畫、程式碼、安全掃描、合規檢查與部署配置。GitLab 是專門設計用以處理整個軟體開發生命週期。

GitLab 是 DevSecOps 的智能 orchestrating 平台，軟體團隊及其人工智慧（"AI"）代理人保持在流動狀態，以更快地交付軟體。建構於統一資料模型之上，我們的平台將開發、運維、資訊科技（"IT"）、安全及業務團隊整合於整個軟體開發生命週期中，以更快地交付更優質且更安全的軟體。
AI 已加速個別編碼，但團隊在協調規劃、測試、安全、部署及運維時會失去動能。分散的工具鏈及工具特定的 AI 代理人會造成瓶頸，延緩軟體交付。GitLab 的智能 orchestrating 可以解決此問題，透過讓團隊協調 AI 代理人，自動執行軟體生命週期中的任務，同時維持品質、安全與速度。
GitLab 透過縮短軟體開發週期從週數至分鐘，加速客戶創新。該平台消除了對個別工具的需求，提高生產力，並透過自動執行強制執行，將安全內建於開發流程中，以提升軟體安全、品質與合規性，同時實現更快的交付。
我們服務所有規模、範疇與複雜度的團隊。因此，我們擁有超過50百萬註冊用戶，且超過50% 的《財富》100 大企業為 GitLab 客戶1。我們將活躍客戶定義為在特定期間內有超過5,000 美元年度重複收入（"ARR"）的客戶，我們稱為 Base Customers。一個組織若擁有獨立子公司、部門或分部，並使用我們的平台，則在計算 ARR 時視為單一客戶。

GitLab 是唯一基於開放核心商業模式建構的 DevSecOps 智能 orchestrating 平台。任何客戶或貢獻者均可透過貢獻程式碼至核心產品或擴充我們的持續整合（"CI"）/持續交付（"CD"）目錄及 AI 目錄，來增加或改善功能。在2025年歷史上，用戶貢獻了超過6,500 個 merge requests，擴充我們的內部研究與發展（"R&D"），並賦能用戶改善他們日常使用的 DevSecOps 解決方案。我們的開放核心方法建立與客戶的信賴，並使我們能維持高創新速度。我們公開我們的策略、方向及產品路線圖。
GitLab 提供靈活的部署選項。客戶可安裝自管理的 GitLab 實例於其內部部署或混合雲環境中，使用我們的完全管理 SaaS 服務於公有或私有雲，或部署 GitLab Dedicated，這是我們為有複雜安全與合規需求的組織提供的單租戶 SaaS 解決方案。
1Fortune 500® 是 Fortune Media IP Limited 登記的商標，經授權使用。此聲稱基於 GitLab 提供的資料。Fortune 100 指 2025 年 Fortune 500 名單中排名前 20% 的公司，於 2025 年 6 月發佈。Fortune 與 Fortune Media IP Limited 並無關聯，也未認可 GitLab 的產品或服務。
請參閱下方「關鍵業務指標—基於美元的淨留存率與 ARR」部分，以取得更多關於我們如何定義 ARR 的資訊。
我們監測以下關鍵指標，以協助我們評估業務、識別影響業務的趨勢、擬定業務計畫，並做出戰略決策。
我們認為，我們從現有客戶所產生的收入留存與擴張能力，是我們客戶關係長期價值與未來業務機會潛力的指標。基於美元的淨留存率衡量我們在特定時點來自客戶羣體的 ARR 變動百分比。我們計算 ARR 以及由此延伸的基於美元的淨留存率，包含自管理與 SaaS 訂閱收入。我們每季以 130% 為門檻報告基於美元的淨留存率，若低於 130%，則報告實際數字。

我們計算 ARR 的方式為將每月重複收入，或 MRR，乘以 12。每個月的 MRR 是透過將該月所有客戶的每月收入，來自承諾的合約金額訂閱收入進行總計，包含我們的自管理與 SaaS 提供服務，但排除專業服務。我們以期末為基準計算基於美元的淨留存率，從該期末前 12 個月的客戶，或稱為 Prior Period ARR 開始計算。我們再計算這些客戶在當前期末的 ARR，或稱為 Current Period ARR。Current Period ARR 的計算包含任何 upsells、價格調整、客戶內用戶數成長、縮減與客戶流失。我們再將總 Current Period ARR 除以總 Prior Period ARR，以得出基於美元的淨留存率。

headings: 與本公司業務及財務狀況相關之風險
資訊安全與隱私權遭入侵可能影響本公司業務。
我們因使用第三方開放原始碼技術，並在產品中整合大量開放原始碼及社羣貢獻之程式碼，而面臨更高的資訊安全風險。
我們面臨激烈競爭，可能失去市場佔有率，此情形將不利於本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況。
我們可能無法以新解決方案回應快速的技術變革，此情形可能對本公司營運成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司服務市場快速演進，成長預期不確定，此情形將不利於本公司未來成果及Class A普通股之交易價格。
本公司營運成果可能大幅波動，此情形可能使本公司未來成果難以預測，並對Class A普通股之交易價格產生不利影響。
我們服務中實施人工智慧及機器學習技術，可能導致聲譽損害、責任、支出增加或其他對本公司營運產生不利後果。
透明度是我們的核心價值之一。雖然我們會繼續優先考量透明度，但也必須推動「負責任的」透明度，因為透明度可能會產生未預期的負面後果。
公開的 GitLab 手冊，或稱為手冊，可能未更新或不正確，這可能會導致第三方的負面質疑，或被用來對我們的業務產生不利影響。
客戶可能會選擇繼續使用我們的免費自管理或 SaaS 產品方案，而非轉為付費客戶。
若無法有效拓展我們的行銷與銷售能力，可能會影響我們擴大客戶羣體及實現服務更廣泛市場接受度的能力。
若未能提供高品質的技術支援服務，包括成功等級，或未能充分銷售這些服務，可能會對我們與客戶的關係及財務結果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表 10-K 中的所有其他資訊，包括標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」的章節，以及我們合併財務報表與附註說明，再做投資決定。本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果或前景，也可能因目前未知或我們認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性而受到不利影響。若任何風險發生，本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景可能受到不利影響。在此情況下，本公司 A 級普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
本公司業務與營運已經歷快速成長，若我們無法適當且有效地管理未來成長，或無法改善我們的系統、流程與控制措施，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景造成不利影響。

我們已經歷快速成長，包括員工人數與客戶數量的增加，以及我們產品需求的增加。我們預期將持續擴充營運並在近期內負責任地增加員工人數，而我們的成功在部分程度上將取決於我們能否有效地管理此成長，儘管我們無法保證成長速度會維持目前的步調。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們的總 Base Customers 數量已成長至 10,682，較 2025 年 1 月 31 日的 9,893 增加。本公司業務的成長與擴張持續對我們的管理與營運及財務資源造成壓力。此外，隨著客戶將我們的產品應用於越來越多的使用情境，我們必須支持更複雜的商業關係。為有效管理並把握成長期，我們需要高效管理員工人數與流程，同時持續投資以改善與擴充我們的資訊科技與財務基礎設施、我們的保安與合規要求、營運與行政系統、與各類夥伴及其他第三方的關係。我們的成長速度也可能因全球營運或總體經濟條件而受到影響，包括通貨膨脹、關稅、利率波動、聯邦預算、債務上限與潛在政府停擺的不確定性、全球債務與股權市場的波動，以及客戶的投資決策。
我們可能無法成功維持產品改進的速度，或無法以高效或及時的方式實施系統、流程與控制措施，或以不會對我們營運結果造成負面影響的方式進行。若無法有效管理成長或改善我們的系統、流程與控制措施，或無法按預期方式運作，將可能對本公司業務造成以下不利影響：客戶部署困難或延遲、品質或客戶滿意度下降、成本增加、難以推出新功能或其他營運困難、無法管理業務成長並準確預測我們的營收、費用與獲利，或防止虧損。
我們近期的成長可能無法代表未來的成長，我們可能無法在未來維持營收成長率。此外，成長也使評估我們未來前景變得困難，並可能增加我們無法成功的風險。
本公司截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日及 2025 年 1 月 31 日的總營收分別為 955.2 百萬美元與 759.2 百萬美元，成長率為 26%。您不應依賴任何先前季度或年度的營收成長率作為未來表現的指標。由於我們作為上市公司歷史有限，我們準確預測未來營運結果的能力受到限制，並受到多種不確定因素的影響，包括我們規劃與建模未來成長的能力
